aksmp.t.ca670208: Main hand = target, off hand = material
aksmp.t.af2bc1bb:
Upgrade: raise an enchantment on the item in your hand by 1 level with coins.

Combine: main hand = target (item or enchanted book), off hand (F key) = material (enchanted book or same kind of item). Same levels give +1, otherwise the higher one. Sharpness, Protection etc. go up to X. Cost = 30 × level².

Book making: 1 book + coins makes a level I book of the enchantment you pick.

Anvils raise them to the same limits.
